ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review: preserve the chat log (driver: "Sit down or I lock the doors." at 22:31:00) and the trip telemetry; obtain the driver's and rider's full accounts; consider interim_suspension of the driver's account per SAFE-4 pending review; do not issue any fare refund in this case.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen (SAFE-1/SAFE-2): the ticket is filed as a safety incident and the rider says the driver "threatened to lock me in" and that she "felt unsafe for the whole ride". The system record corroborates a threat-like message: at 22:30:05 the rider sent "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." and at 22:31:00 the driver replied, in-app, "Sit down or I lock the doors." The GPS track shows a stop (0.4 km/h on Buyong Road at 22:31:10) exactly between those two messages, so the message was sent while the car was stationary and the rider had asked to alight — it reads as a conditional threat to confine the rider, not a pickup arrangement or a mere safety instruction. The driver's statement ("I told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on") does not deny the locking threat. This is a dangerous/harassment-type allegation with a documentary basis, so the case is screened as a confirmed safety concern. Under SAFE-1/SAFE-2/SAFE-3 the AI may only gather evidence and prepare the file; it may not rule on the merits. I therefore escalate rather than determine fault or any refund. For completeness on the non-safety arithmetic (not ruled on): the actual distance (15.472 km) equals the recommended distance (15.472 km), so there is no deviation over the 1 km tolerance (RD-1); the fare is at surge 1.0x with no surge change and no cancellation fee, so no fare element is in dispute. Escalation reason: alleged threat to lock the rider in, evidenced by the driver's own in-app message, requires human review of possible confinement/intimidation and safe-drop-off obligations. TH-2 also routes safety cases to human review; interim measures under SAFE-4 are available to the reviewer.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the record contains a documented threat/intimidation indicator (driver's in-app 'Sit down or I lock the doors.' after the rider asked to get out, with GPS showing the car stopped at that moment). Per SAFE-1/SAFE-2/SAFE-3 the AI may not rule, assign fault or recommend an outcome on safety incidents; the case file goes to a human reviewer, who may consider interim suspension under SAFE-4.

element_findings.element: Safety screen over chat, complaint and driver statement (SAFE-1/SAFE-2)
element_findings.reason: A threat/intimidation indicator (locking the rider in after she asked to exit) is present and documented; the case must be escalated, not ruled.
Actual 15.472 km equals recommended 15.472 km; deviation 0 km, inside the 1 km tolerance, so no deviation refund arises.
Multiplier at trip start is 1.0x with no change from quote; there is no surge differential to refund.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's account ('Sit down for her own safety') is a claim about intent; it does not outweigh his own contemporaneous in-app message 'Sit down or I lock the doors.' sent while the vehicle was stopped and the rider had asked to get out. Safety determination is reserved to the human reviewer.

safety_basis: Rider's in-app request to stop and get out ('Please stop the car, I want to get out here.', 22:30:05) followed by the driver's in-app message 'Sit down or I lock the doors.' (22:31:00), sent while the vehicle was stationary per GPS (0.4 km/h, Buyong Road, 22:31:10)
Rider complaint: 'The driver threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out. I felt unsafe for the whole ride.'
Driver statement does not deny the locking threat: 'I told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on.'
